title: One base rule for every highlight
blurb: Three named highlights share one ::highlight(*) rule for underline and colour; a fourth registered at runtime picks it up with no new CSS.
question: What is the minimum CSS and JS to give every registered highlight a shared base style that named rules can override?
result: One ::highlight(*) rule in its own constructed stylesheet styled typo, todo and a late-registered date highlight (dotted underline); the name highlight's own rule kept solid; removing the sheet removed the base from all of them.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 (Linux, headless, no flags) on 2026-11-27
